title: Commit Locally, Exit Globally: Coordinating Adaptive Sampling and Early Exit in Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.28166v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion language models expose a provisional prediction at every denoising step, and on many tasks the candidate answer inside it stabilizes before the step schedule is exhausted. This creates two acceleration opportunities, leaving a block early and stopping the sequence early, but the two require different criteria because block acceleration is local whereas sequence termination is global and freezes the graded answer. Existing methods usually optimize only one axis, and existing exit gates rely on fixed-region confidence or schedule-dependent rules rather than the candidate answer itself. We present $\textbf{C}^4$, which coordinates the two axes by giving each decision its own gate. $\textbf{C}$onfidence-Verified Early Exit (CVEE) decides when the sequence may stop, requiring confidence and sustained argmax stability over a candidate span re-extracted at every step. $\textbf{C}$ommit-$\textbf{C}$ore-Then-$\textbf{C}$onfirm

translated_title: 本地提交，全局退出：协调扩散语言模型中的自适应采样与提前退出
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.28166v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：扩散语言模型在每个去噪步骤中都会暴露一个临时预测，在许多任务中，其内部候选答案在步骤计划耗尽之前就已稳定。这创造了两个加速机会：提前离开块和提前停止序列，但两者需要不同的标准，因为块加速是局部的，而序列终止是全局的并冻结了分级答案。现有方法通常只优化一个轴，且现有退出门依赖于固定区域置信度或计划相关规则，而非候选答案本身。我们提出$\textbf{C}^4$，通过为每个决策分配独立的门来协调这两个轴。$\textbf{C}$onfidence-Verified Early Exit (CVEE) 决定序列何时可以停止，要求在每个步骤重新提取的候选跨度上具有置信度和持续的argmax稳定性。$\textbf{C}$ommit-$\textbf{C}$ore-Then-$\textbf{C}$onfirm 则处理局部块加速。
tldr: 提出了一种协调局部块加速与全局序列终止的双门机制，通过基于候选答案的置信度验证实现更高效的扩散语言模型加速。
en_tdlr: A dual-gate mechanism coordinating local block acceleration and global sequence termination, enabling more efficient diffusion language model acceleration via confidence-verified candidate-based exit.
